course_name_original: Fundamentals of Casting, Forming and Welding
course_name_en: Fundamentals of Casting, Forming and Welding
prerequisites: 100% participation at seminars. Potential absence can be replaced with another group according to the schedule and as agreed with the teacher.
Successful completion of the final test.

learning_outcomes.text: To present the historical context of metallurgical production in relation to production technologies.
Clearly inform about typical casting, forming and welding technologies.

syllabus_topics: Introduction: Basic concepts
Introduction: Engineering manufacturing technology
Introduction: Distribution and importance of manufacturing processes in engineering disciplines
Introduction: Properties of metals and alloys
Introduction: Production of steel and cast iron
Introduction: Metal Industry, the equilibrium diagram iron-iron carbid
Foundry: History of metallurgy, concepts of iron and steel
Foundry: Technical metals and alloys, their properties in terms of technology production and use
Foundry: Properties of cast metals in terms of production technology
Foundry: Castings, rules for construction and design of castings, intake system and risers
Foundry: The production of foundry molds, foundry sand mixture, the model device (pattern)
Foundry: Selected casting technologies - principles, casted metals, typical castings
Welding: Methods Welding - classification, different methods
Welding: Characteristics of the various types of welding, metallurgy of the weld
Welding: Comparison with rivets welding, forging and casting
Welding: Flame welding - types of flames, gases, usage
Welding: Manual MMA - principle, the distribution of electrodes, the use of technologies
Welding: Welding in protective atmosphere
Welding: Types of joints and welds
Welding: Metal cutting with oxygen
Welding: Resistance welding
Metal Forming: Forming history, basic concepts, a division forming technologies
Metal Forming: Heating of materials, heating equipment
Metal Forming: Basic principles of forming machines
Metal Forming: The description of plane forming and bulk-forming technology
Metal Forming: A description of other equipment of mills and forges
Basics of other manufactruring and finishing technologies.
Introductory lesson (Tutorials)
Practical exercises - Casting (Tutorials)
Practical exercises - Forming (Tutorials)
Practical exercises - Welding (Tutorials)
Summarizing lesson (Tutorials)
The final test (Tutorials)
